articles.title: Simulating the Two-Heads-in-a-Row Puzzle in 20 Lines of Python
articles.excerpt: You flip a fair coin until you get two heads in a row. How many flips does it take, on average? Most people say 4. It feels right: two flips for HH would be 4 if you somehow "double" a 50/50 wait. The…
articles.body: You flip a fair coin until you get two heads in a row. How many flips does it take, on average? Most people say 4. It feels right: two flips for HH would be 4 if you somehow "double" a 50/50 wait. The real answer is 6 . That gap between gut and math is why this puzzle is a favorite for learning expected value with states. Below is a tiny Monte Carlo simulation that estimates the answer, then a short explanation of why six is exact. The simulation import random def flips_until_two_heads (): streak = 0 n = 0 while streak < 2 : n += 1 if random . random () < 0.5 : streak += 1 else : streak = 0 return n TRIALS = 100_000 total = sum ( flips_until_two_heads () for _ in range ( TRIALS )) print ( total / TRIALS ) Run it a few times.

articles.title: How to Calculate Your Real Hourly Rate as a Freelancer
articles.excerpt: Take a freelance designer and call her Dana. She's made up, but her month is ordinary. Four clients each pay a $2,400 invoice on time. That's $9,600 collected before payment processing fees. She logge…
articles.body: Take a freelance designer and call her Dana. She's made up, but her month is ordinary. Four clients each pay a $2,400 invoice on time. That's $9,600 collected before payment processing fees. She logged 80 billable hours, which puts her rate at $120 an hour, a number she'll feel good about for roughly a minute. Then she counts the rest of the month. Proposals, invoicing, client calls, revisions. Work that took time but never appeared on a bill. Once she includes those hours and her business costs, the number looks very different. Dana's real hourly rate comes out at about $75. After self-employment tax, about $64. Same month, same checks.

articles.title: 4-billion-year-old 'Rosetta Stone' found in Sahara Desert could unlock the secret history of water on Mars
articles.excerpt: A rock discovered in the Sahara Desert formed more than 4.1 billion years ago, making it one of the oldest Martian meteorites ever found. The ancient space rock offers a rare glimpse into the formatio…
articles.body: A rose-colored rock discovered in the Sahara Desert may hold some clues to Mars' ancient geological history. The meteorite , named Teghaza 001 after the salt plain in Mali where it was discovered in 2022, weighs roughly 1.8 pounds (800 grams) and formed more than 4.1 billion years ago. Blasted off Mars by an impact before eventually landing on Earth, it is one of the three oldest Martian meteorites ever found. The extraordinary age and unusual mineral composition of Teghaza 001 offer a rare glimpse into the formation of Mars' early crust and how volcanic materials may have been altered by water, according to a statement from NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California.

articles.body: What is it about the Apple Watch? articles.title: Boxshelf is a new Android front-end that turns your ROMs into a virtual collection
articles.excerpt: This new front-end turns your ROMs into gorgeous virtual game boxes, just in case you miss your physical collection.
articles.body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR A new Android front-end called Boxshelf has been released on GitHub. This launcher emphasizes box art, with games being displayed as 3D boxes that you can inspect. Boxshelf also includes a museum view to show off your games on a digital shelf. There’s no shortage of front-ends or launchers for Android handhelds . We’ve got staples like ES-DE and Beacon, while new entrants like Socket and Play Field Portal have also made their mark. However, Boxshelf is the latest front-end to land on Android, and it might be up your alley if you miss physical games. Boxshelf launched on GitHub yesterday as a gaming-focused front-end for Windows and Steam Deck, but the most recent update has brought an Android version.

articles.title: 'We got it done!' Spacewalking astronauts finish installing next-gen ISS solar arrays
articles.excerpt: Spacewalkers Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk installed the final ISS Roll-Out Solar Array on Thursday (Nov. 5), wrapping up a multiyear effort to boost the station's power generation by 30%.
articles.body: Just as NASA is preparing to demonstrate " Max Power " on the ground, two astronauts on a spacewalk have provided the International Space Station (ISS) with the same. Expedition 75 flight engineers Anil Menon of NASA and Joshua Kutryk of the Canadian Space Agency installed and deployed the eighth and final ISS Roll-Out Solar Array (iROSA) on Thursday (Nov. 5), augmenting the space station's legacy solar array wings to produce as much as 30% more electricity. "We got it done!" said Menon at the end of the 6-hour-and-59-minute spacewalk . The EVA (extravehicular activity) began at 8:36 a.m. EST and ended at 3:35 p.m. EST (1336 to 2035 GMT).

articles.title: Andy Weir says his new sci-fi audio drama 'Exoplanet' is a way to 'revive the old art of radio plays' (interview)
articles.excerpt: "Earlier on in my life, even before 'The Martian,' I wanted to bring back audio-only entertainment."
articles.body: Hot off the tremendous theatrical success of this year's "Project Hail Mary," adapted from Andy Weir's 2021 novel of the same name, the New York Times bestselling author is rocketing back into deep space with a brand new Audible Original release landing on Nov. 5, 2026, titled " Exoplanet ." Weir (" The Martian ") is executive producing this ambitious full-cast audiobook drama with acclaimed author and ace comic writer Benjamin Percy ("Wolverine") for the first in a series of curated sci-fi projects for Amazon's Audible. The seven-episode sci-fi thriller stars the vocal talents of Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose, and John Leguizamo in a wild time-travel space disaster odyssey that also benefits from Lucasfilm’s Skywalker Sound, which provided the show’s immersive acoustic elements.
